notFound.body: This address doesn’t match a screen in Coffer.

hiddenNames.title: {count, plural, one {This name has hidden characters} other {# names have hidden characters}}
hiddenNames.body: Direction and zero-width characters can make a name look like another file type. Each one is shown below as ⟨U+XXXX⟩, in the order it is stored.
hiddenNames.more: {count, plural, one {and # more name} other {and # more names}}

offline.body: Operations pause until the connection returns.
offline.title: You’re offline

conn.removeBody: This only changes this browser. Your bucket and its files are not touched. These are removed from this device:
conn.removeTransfers: {count, plural, one {# running or waiting transfer, stopped} other {# running or waiting transfers, stopped}}
conn.removeUploads: {count, plural, one {# unfinished upload, cancelled at your provider} other {# unfinished uploads, cancelled at your provider}}
conn.removeStarred: {count, plural, one {# starred item} other {# starred items}}
conn.removeRecent: {count, plural, one {# recent file} other {# recent files}}
conn.removeKeep: Other connections, their transfers and your passphrase stay as they are.
conn.removedUploads: Removed {name}. {aborted} of {total} unfinished uploads cancelled at your provider.
conn.removedUploadsFailed: Removed {name}. {aborted} of {total} unfinished uploads cancelled at your provider; {failed} could not be and may still use space there.
conn.blockedBody: {name} has {count, plural, one {a move that was cut off} other {# moves that were cut off}}. Removing it now would lose track of {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Resume or discard each one, then remove the connection.
conn.blockedLive: Still running. Try again when it finishes.
conn.testPassedBody: Coffer reached the provider, listed, wrote, read and deleted a test file.
conn.testFailedBody: The failed step says what went wrong. Check the provider’s CORS rule and the key’s permissions, then try again.
conn.nameHint: Shown in the switcher and here. The endpoint, region and bucket can’t be changed: add a new connection instead.
conn.renameFailed: Couldn’t save the name. Unlock and try again.
conn.subtitle: {connection} · {state}

zip.warn: This folder is about {size}. Large downloads can run out of memory in some browsers.

err.empty: Enter a name for the folder.
err.exists: A folder named {name} already exists here.
err.tooLong: That name is too long. A key can be at most 1,024 bytes.
err.dots: A folder can’t be named “.” or “..”.
err.failed: Couldn’t create the folder. Check that this key can write here, then try again.

err.tooLong: That name is too long. A key can be at most 1,024 bytes.
err.invalid: That name has characters a bucket can’t store.

err.slash: Names can’t contain slashes. The copy is saved in the same folder.

err.inside: A folder can’t be moved into itself.
err.same: This is where it already is. Choose another folder.

move.loadError: Couldn’t load this folder. Try again.

trash.title: Move to trash?
trash.body: {count, plural, one {{name} will} other {# items will}} be moved to the trash folder. You can restore {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} from Trash.

capped.body: Coffer stopped loading at {count} items, so the list is incomplete.
capped.title: Showing the first {count} items

emptyBucket.body: Upload your first file, drag a folder in, or create a folder with New.

partial.sortNote: Sorting by size or date only orders the items loaded so far.

pageError.title: Couldn’t load more items after {count}
pageError.body: The items already loaded are still shown.

error.denied: This key isn’t allowed to list this folder. Your files are not affected.
error.generic: Something went wrong while listing this folder. Your files are not affected.

download.multi: Downloads start one after another. Your browser may ask to allow multiple downloads.
download.error: Couldn’t start the download. Try again.

emptyFolder.bodyPhone: Upload files or a folder, or create a folder.

endpoint.credentials: Remove the username and password from the endpoint address.
endpoint.insecure: Use an https address. Plain http only works for localhost.
endpoint.invalid: That isn’t a valid address. Start with https://.
endpoint.label: One part of the address has a character it can’t contain. Use letters, digits and hyphens.
endpoint.query: Remove the ? and anything after it from the endpoint address.

error.prefix: Use a folder path such as photos/2026, with no “..” and no empty parts.
error.region: Enter a region. This endpoint doesn’t tell Coffer which one to sign with.

prefix.hint: Optional. Coffer opens in this folder and can’t go above it. Use it for a key limited to one folder.

tokenExpires.hint: Optional. Share links stop working at this time. Without it, links last at most 1 hour.

cors.anyBucket: the bucket you want to use
cors.stepOpen: Open the CORS settings for {target} in your {provider} account.
cors.stillFailing: Still failing? Some providers send error responses without CORS headers, so a wrong key can look like a CORS problem. Check the key and the rule, then try again.

cred.browserWarn: {provider} may not allow browser access. Coffer will try, but the CORS check can fail even with a correct rule.

clean.next: Rename, move and delete need delete access. Give the key delete access, then try again.
clean.title: This key can’t delete files
clean.why: The test file was written, but the key isn’t allowed to delete it.

localNetwork.next: Open the site settings for this page, set Local network access to Allow, then test again. You can find them by clicking the icon at the left of the address bar.
localNetwork.title: Your browser blocked access to your local network
localNetwork.why: {endpoint} is on this device or your local network, and the browser needs your permission to reach it.

missing.next: Check the bucket name and the endpoint, then try again.
missing.title: Bucket not found
missing.why: {bucket} doesn’t exist at {endpoint}, or this key can’t see it.

sig.whyUnknown: The secret key may have a stray space, or your device clock may be wrong.

unknown.next: Check the endpoint, region and keys, then try again.
unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.why: The provider answered in a way Coffer didn’t expect.

localNetwork.body: {endpoint} is on this device or your local network. Choose Allow when the browser asks, so Coffer can run the test.
localNetwork.title: Your browser will ask to reach your local network

locked.transfers: {count, plural, one {# transfer is still finishing in the background.} other {# transfers are still finishing in the background.}}
locked.manual: You locked Coffer. Your files are safe. Enter your passphrase to continue.
locked.elsewhere: Coffer was locked in another tab. Enter your passphrase to continue.

memory.remote: Coffer was locked from another tab. This connection wasn’t saved, so enter its keys again.
memory.local: Coffer was locked. This connection wasn’t saved, so enter its keys again.
memory.kept: The provider, endpoint and bucket are kept. Only the keys need to be typed again.

paste.expiryIgnored: Ignored the credential expiration because it isn’t a future time.
paste.noMatch: Nothing recognized. Paste AWS-style environment lines, an rclone remote, or an endpoint.
paste.providerMismatch: This rclone remote names a different provider than {provider}. Coffer filled what it could, so check each value.

pick.none: This key can’t see any buckets. Type the name of the one you want to open.
pick.title: Choose a bucket

ro.unverified: This bucket is empty, so Coffer couldn’t confirm that reading works.

save.strong: Strong. 16 characters or more is best.
save.tooShort: Use at least 12 characters. A longer passphrase is harder to guess.
save.label: Passphrase
save.reuse: Your saved connections share one passphrase, so you won’t be asked for a new one.
save.failed: Couldn’t save the connection. Check that this browser allows site storage, then try again.
save.existing: Enter the passphrase of your saved connections. They all share one passphrase.

unlock.wait: Too many tries. Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} before trying again.
unlock.failed: Couldn’t open the saved connections. Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, forget this device and add the connection again.

none.bodyFolder: Only names in {folder} were searched, not the folders inside it. Try a shorter word, remove a filter or search all of the bucket.
none.bodyRoot: Only names at the top of {bucket} were searched, not the folders inside it. Try a shorter word, remove a filter or search all of the bucket.

scope.partial: Results cover the {count} items loaded so far.

search.placeholderRoot: Search names at the top of {bucket}

everywhere.title: Results in all of {bucket}
everywhere.capped: Searched the first {count} names in {bucket}. Results may be incomplete.
everywhere.error: The search stopped after {count} names because the provider didn’t answer. Try again.
everywhere.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
everywhere.hint: Hidden files and the trash are not searched. Turn on hidden files in Settings to include them.

share.error: Couldn’t create the link. Try again.

reason.folder: Only a single file can be shared.

session.none: Your session token expires in under 15 minutes, so a link can’t be created. Use new credentials.
session.unknown: Coffer doesn’t know when this token expires, so links last at most 1 hour.

share.title: Share “{name}”

idle.estimate: About {requests} requests, based on the last count of {count} objects.
idle.rule: Coffer needs about one request per 1,000 objects.

cancelled.title: Calculation stopped
cancelled.body: Counted {count} objects before you stopped. Nothing was changed.

error.title: Usage couldn’t be calculated
error.body: Counted {count} objects before the provider stopped answering. Try again.

stor.stillBody: Over 100,000 objects counted. Large buckets can take several minutes; you can stop at any time.
stor.scope: Counts everything in {bucket}, including the trash.

toast.restored: Restored {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
toast.deleted: Deleted {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} forever
toast.deleteFailed: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} could not be deleted
toast.starred: {count, plural, one {Added # item to starred} other {Added # items to starred}}
toast.unstarred: {count, plural, one {Removed # item from starred} other {Removed # items from starred}}
toast.movedTo: {count, plural, one {Moved # item to {folder}} other {Moved # items to {folder}}}

error.title: Couldn’t read the trash
error.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.

emptyState.title: Trash is empty
emptyState.body: Items you move to trash show up here until you empty it.

failures.title: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} could not be deleted

interrupted.body: {name} was interrupted when the page closed. Start it again.
interrupted.title: Upload interrupted

error.denied: This key isn’t allowed to write here.
error.network: The connection dropped before the upload finished.
error.cors: The bucket didn’t return the part’s ETag. Add ETag to ExposeHeaders in its CORS rule.
error.quota: The provider refused this file: it is too large or the account is out of space.
error.throttled: The provider is asking Coffer to slow down. Try again in a moment.
error.generic: The upload failed. Your other files are not affected.

rejected.one: {name} can’t be uploaded: its name is too long or has characters a bucket can’t store.
rejected.many: {count} files can’t be uploaded: their names are too long or have characters a bucket can’t store.

upl.checkError: Couldn’t check which files already exist. Nothing was uploaded; try again.

pv.label: Preview of {name}
pv.truncated: Only the first 1 MiB is shown.

html.sandboxNote: Shown in a sandbox: scripts, forms, popups and remote resources are blocked, and styles may not apply.

op.error: Couldn’t start that. Nothing was changed. Check that this key can write here, then try again.

review.label: Review
review.title: Moving “{name}”
review.source: Still in the source: {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}}
review.target: Already in the destination: {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}}
review.error: Couldn’t read the folders. Nothing was changed.

interrupted.bodyFailed: {done} of {total} objects in {name} were moved. {failed, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} could not be moved.

op.discarded: Discarded. Some objects are in the destination and some are still in {name}; nothing was deleted.
op.resumeSettled: This operation already finished or was discarded.
op.resumeElsewhere: This operation is running in another tab.
op.titleDelete: Deleting {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} forever

keepFolder.sub: The new folder is saved as {name}.

merge.sub: Files with the same name are replaced. Files only in the existing folder stay.

lock.title: Lock Coffer now?
lock.body: Transfers that are already running keep going. You’ll enter your passphrase to continue.
lock.sub: Clears the keys from this tab and every other tab of Coffer.

sec.autolockNeverWarn: Without auto-lock, anyone who opens this browser can use your saved connections.
sec.noSaved: No connections are saved on this device. Keys stay in memory and are gone when you close the tab.

forget.failed: Couldn’t finish forgetting this device. Reload the page and try again.

reveal.memoryOnly: This connection isn’t saved, so its secret key can’t be shown again.
reveal.wrong: That passphrase doesn’t match. Check for caps lock and try again.
reveal.failed: Couldn’t read the saved key. Try again.

uploads.sub: {count, plural, one {# unfinished upload} other {# unfinished uploads}} · no file contents

star.missing: Not found in {bucket}. It was moved or deleted outside Coffer.

kb.star: Add to or remove from starred
kb.toggle: Add to or remove from the selection
kb.escape: Close the top layer, then clear the selection
kb.title: Keyboard shortcuts
kb.note: Single-key shortcuts work while the file list has focus, never while you type.
